about: What user-flow judges each H3 15 s Turbo clip against (8 steps: 4 dense, then 4 sparse), per SKU x GPUs: a run more than 5% slower fails (Paul 11-15: within 5% is a tie). The 0.25.0 gates, cozy 0.25.0, Runtime 0.46.0, minimax-h3@0.12.0 on its int8 lane: rtx-4090 from release-gate 43217306537 (shirayuki, TensorFS 0.25.0; runs 9-12 one GPU, 13-16 two), rtx-5090 from 43233812383 (roxas, TensorFS 0.25.1; cold runs 9, 13, 15, 17, warm 10). Dense is steps 2-4, sparse steps 5-8, medians. h100x1 is Paul's word (11-16): a 15 s H3 Turbo clip in about 6 min on one H100. A function or SKU with no entry is recorded, not judged: its first green run's numbers go here.
